title: Early jungle tracking ward
text: I always ward the enemy raptors when I'm on blue side, and the enemy blue buff when I'm on red side, so I know which way the enemy jungler is pathing. If they're pathing toward me, I play carefully around 3:00. If not, I know I can play aggressively in lane.

title: Youmuu's Ghostblade as core
text: I prefer Youmuu's Ghostblade as my core item because it works like a second Ghost, which suits my playstyle much better. Only suggest Stridebreaker as the core item if it is very strong in this specific matchup, and say why.

title: Crit Darius when viable
text: I find it fun to build crit on Darius. If crit is viable in the matchup, or once I'm ahead, suggest a crit build path to me.
